label: Morning Brief
timezoneNote: All times shown in ET (America/New_York). Items marked headline were written only from the publisher's headline and summary. The overnight news snapshot was not available for this run, so coverage is limited to items published through 5:32 PM ET on Nov 16.

driver.text: Per the Financial Times, the Nasdaq 100 sank 2.7% on Monday as US chip stocks fell amid fresh selling pressure on Nvidia, in a gloomy start to a pivotal week for the AI trade (4:58 PM ET). Per Bloomberg, Asian stocks were set to decline, tracking Wall Street losses as investors stayed wary of the AI trade ahead of Nvidia's earnings and Anthropic's expected market debut (5:06 PM ET). Written from headlines and publisher summaries only.

calendar.text: Nvidia is due to report earnings, per WSJ, amid its CEO leadership change.
Anthropic's public listing is expected, per WSJ.
A slate of Federal Reserve speeches and the central bank's most recent meeting minutes are due, per Bloomberg.

cryptoDriver.text: Per WSJ, Bitcoin and Ethereum were trading around key support levels as risk appetite remained constrained. Written from the headline and summary only.
